# decision-011: Use ORM-independent persistence records, async SQLAlchemy repositories, and an explicit application-owned unit of work for submissions, logical source threads, posts, and Telegram projections.

- Status: `superseded`
- Freshness: `historical`
- Area: `architecture`
- Recorded: `2026-10-17`
- Last verified: `2026-10-17`
- Tags: `alembic`, `persistence`, `repository`, `sqlalchemy`, `unit-of-work`
- Scope: merged into main by pull-request-15 at 0dca318 Historical snapshot as recorded 2026-10-17. Preserve dated implementation details here; successor decision restates only the durable core contract.

## Rationale and consequences

Stable provider/channel keys own thread identity; source media deduplication is independent of thread; Telegram projections require chat and message IDs; tail changes use optimistic versions; repositories never commit. SQLite migrations share explicit BEGIN hooks with application transactions. UoW sessions close permanently and discard repository state. Full display snapshots clear removed usernames. SQLAlchemy minimum is 2.0.22.
